text:
rachel-ops: Quick announcement: Nebula N100 dedicated pools will enter a rotating soft-open window in sao-paulo-3 and dublin-2 on 2026-05-10 14:00 UTC. This is for validation and experimental workloads only — please hold production migrations until GA.

liang-eng: What's the target memory / perf footprint compared to current fleet?

rachel-ops: Nebula N100 = 96GB VRAM, native sparsity support, expected FP16 throughput ~1.4x vs current gen H100p in our internal microbench. Numbers preliminary.

ops-bot: System notice: pools/nebula-n100 labeled as "rotational-beta". Warm-window = 3h, cold-reserve allowed but lower placement priority. Preemptible cap = 25% of pool. See policy doc: https://intranet.redwood/policies/dedicated-rotation (internal).

liang-eng: Any changes to reservation semantics or fairshare?

rachel-ops: New nuance: reservations created with --priority high will still not guarantee placement in beta pools. Fairshare weightings apply; reserved buckets > committed tier still get preference over ad-hoc warm reservations.

tara-sre: Oncall / thermal constraints: N100 racks run at 12kW nominal. If you see thermal trips tag @tara-sre and escalate to #eng-oncall. Runbook: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/nebula-n100.

kevin-product: Billing / experiment tracking: use billing tag nebula-beta-may2026 in reservation metadata. We'll add a Console filter but include the tag now.

rachel-ops: Reservation CLI sample:
```
# reserve 1 GPU in nebula-n100 pool in sao-paulo-3 for 2 hours starting 2026-05-10T14:00Z
rdrctl reserve --pool nebula-n100 --region sao-paulo-3 --count 1 --start 2026-05-10T14:00Z --duration 2h --meta "charge=nebula-beta-may2026"
```

liang-eng: grabbing one for a short encoder-only smoke test.

ops-bot: Reservation confirmed (id: 46789) for liang-eng — pool: nebula-n100, region: sao-paulo-3, start: 2026-05-10T14:00Z, duration: 2h.

tara-sre: Note for infra teams: N100 firmware pinned to v1.2.4 for beta. Please do NOT apply firmware upgrades on these racks during the window.

legal-bot: Heads up: do not process regulated customer data in beta pools. Compliance clearance required before any PHI/PCI workloads.

sofia-ps: We'll publish a short checklist for partners (how to opt in / test) by EOD.

rachel-ops: Thanks all. If you find perf regressions open a ticket with "nebula-n100-beta" and paste traces here. We'll monitor metrics and pause window if needed. :eyes:
